command.name: security key-manager external aws show
command.description: This command displays the Amazon Web Service Key Management Service (AWSKMS) configuration for a given Vserver.

parameter.name: vserver
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AWSKMS configuration for the given Vserver.

parameter.name: region
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AWSKMS configuration with the given region.

parameter.name: access-key-id
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AWSKMS configuration with the given access key ID.

parameter.name: state
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AWSKMS configurations with the given state. The state can be either available or unknown.

parameter.name: unavailable-nodes
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AWSKMS configurations with the given unavailable-nodes.

parameter.name: key-id
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AWSKMS configuration with the given key-id.

parameter.name: service
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AWSKMS configurations with the given AWS service type.

parameter.name: default-domain
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AWSKMS configurations with the given AWS KMS default domain.

parameter.name: polling-period
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AWSKMS configurations with the given polling period.

parameter.name: port
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AWSKMS configurations with the given AWS KMS port.

parameter.name: host
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AWSKMS configurations with the given AWS KMS host name.

parameter.name: verify
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AWSKMS configurations with the given value of the verify flag.

parameter.name: verify-host
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AWSKMS configurations with the given value of the verify-host flag.

parameter.name: verify-ip
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AWSKMS configurations with the given value of the verify-ip flag.

parameter.name: encryption-context
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command displays only the AWSKMS configurations with the given value of the AWS encryption-context. The parameter should be in JSON format.

example.p: The following example lists all AWSKMS configurations.
example.screen:
cluster-1::>security key-manager external aws show Vserver: SAMPLE_VSERVER Region: SAMPLE_NA_REGION
Access Key Id State ------------------------------------------ ------- SAMPLE_ACCESS_KEY_ID unknown SAMPLE_ACCESS_KEY_ID_2 unknown Unavailable Nodes: node1
example.p: The following example lists the AWSKMS configurations that have the given encryption context of "{"team": "NVEsecurity"}".
example.screen:
cluster-1::>security key-manager external aws show -encryption-context {"team": "NVEsecurity"} Vserver: SAMPLE_VSERVER Region: SAMPLE_NA_REGION
Access Key Id State ------------------------------------------ ------- SAMPLE_ACCESS_KEY_ID unknown Unavailable Nodes: node1
